Navigate to /lessons

Verify unit-1 and unit-2 appear under A0-A1 section

title: Dashboard shows CEFR estimate badge
description: Dashboard YourProgressCard shows the learner's cefr_estimate badge (e.g. 'A0') from profile
steps: Navigate to http://localhost:5173/dashboard
Log in if needed
Find the YourProgressCard widget
Verify it shows a CEFR estimate badge (e.g. 'A0' or 'A1')

title: Database migration creates units and modules tables

steps: Check backend can query units table by calling GET /api/v1/levels
Verify the response lists CEFR levels and their unit counts
Navigate to http://localhost:5173/lessons
Verify lesson units load from the database (not just static TS data)

title: Anthropic package installed in backend
description: anthropic>=0.40 is in requirements.txt and importable
steps: Navigate to http://localhost:8000/api/v1/health
Verify it responds without 500 errors
Check that ai_tutor_enabled field is present in the response

title: AI tutor /explain endpoint returns explanation
description: POST /api/v1/me/ai-tutor/explain returns { explanation } JSON when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY present, or { code: 'ai_disabled' } when absent
steps: Log in to the app
Navigate to a lesson section
Click the 'Ask Tutor' button
Type a question in the Explain tab (e.g. 'What does present simple mean?')
Click submit and verify a response appears
Verify the response is relevant English grammar explanation

title: AI tutor /correct endpoint returns 4-block correction
description: POST /api/v1/me/ai-tutor/correct returns { original, corrected, explanation, explanation_l1, try_again_prompt, try_again_answer }
steps: Log in to the app
Open the AI Tutor panel
Click the Correct tab
Enter a sentence with a grammar mistake (e.g. 'I go to market yesterday')
Submit and verify the response shows: Your sentence, Better sentence, Why, Try again

title: AI tutor /practice endpoint returns drill items
description: POST /api/v1/me/ai-tutor/practice returns { items[] } array of drill questions
steps: Log in to the app
Open the AI Tutor panel
Click the Practice tab
Select a skill to practice (e.g. 'Grammar')
Click 'Generate Practice' and verify a list of exercises appears
Verify each exercise has a question and answer

title: AI tutor /writing-coach endpoint returns feedback
description: POST /api/v1/me/ai-tutor/writing-coach returns { scores, inline_annotations, rewritten_exemplar }
steps: Log in to the app
Open the AI Tutor panel
Click the Writing Coach tab
Paste a short paragraph (e.g. 'Yesterday I go to market and buyed some food.')
Click 'Get Feedback' and verify the response shows skill scores and annotations

title: AI Tutor Panel slide-out renders correctly
description: Global slide-out AiTutorPanel opens from sidebar button or 'Ask Tutor' FAB; has 4 tabs: Explain, Correct, Practice, Writing Coach
steps: Log in and navigate to /home
Look for 'AI Tutor' item in the sidebar nav
Click it and verify a right slide-out panel appears
Verify the panel has tabs: Explain, Correct, Practice, Writing Coach
Verify the panel has a close button
Navigate to a lesson page and verify floating 'Ask Tutor' button appears (bottom-right)

title: Explain tab streams AI response
description: In the Explain tab, typing a question and submitting shows streamed text response appearing token by token
steps: Open AI Tutor panel and click Explain tab
Type 'What is the difference between present simple and present continuous?'
Click submit
Verify text appears progressively (streaming), not all at once
Verify the explanation is relevant and complete

title: Correct tab shows AiCorrectionBlock format
description: Correction response renders as 4 blocks: Your sentence / Better sentence / Why / Try again with fill-in input
steps: Open AI Tutor panel, click Correct tab
Enter 'She don't like coffee' and submit
Verify 4 sections appear: 'Your sentence:', 'Better sentence:', 'Why:', 'Try again:'
Verify the 'Better sentence' shows in green text
Verify the 'Try again' section has a fill-in input field

title: Writing Coach tab renders AiFeedbackPanel
description: Writing Coach response shows scores grid, inline annotations on submitted text, and collapsed rewritten exemplar
steps: Open AI Tutor panel, click Writing Coach tab
Paste a paragraph with errors and click 'Get Feedback'
Verify a scores grid appears with skill bars (vocabulary, grammar, organization, etc.)
Verify the submitted text is shown with highlighted spans for errors
Verify a collapsed 'Show stronger version' section appears

title: Sidebar has new nav items (Review, Skills, Conversations, AI Tutor)
description: AppSidebar shows: Review (with badge), Skills, Conversations, AI Tutor after Lessons
steps: Log in and navigate to /home
Look at the sidebar navigation
Verify 'Review' item appears with a badge showing due item count (or hidden when 0)
Verify 'Skills' item appears
Verify 'Conversations' item appears
Verify 'AI Tutor' item appears

title: Database has 24 seed AI conversation scenarios
description: ai_scenarios table has all 24 scenarios from spec including: introduce-yourself-a1, order-coffee-a1, ask-name-age-a1, etc.
steps: Navigate to http://localhost:5173/u/:username/conversations/scenarios
Log in if needed
Verify the scenarios picker shows at least 24 scenarios
Verify scenarios are grouped by level (A0-A1, A1-A2, etc.)

title: Start conversation session endpoint works

steps: Navigate to the scenarios picker page
Click 'Start mission' on a scenario (e.g. 'Order a coffee')
Verify the app navigates to the live mission page
Verify the AI opening line appears in the chat area
Verify the target vocabulary panel shows vocab chips on the right

title: Conversation turn endpoint streams SSE response
description: POST /api/v1/me/conversations/:id/turn streams SSE events (metadata, token, done) for AI response
steps: Start a conversation session
Type a message (e.g. 'Can I have a coffee, please?') and send
Verify AI response text appears progressively (streaming)
Verify the turn is recorded in the chat history
Verify target vocab chips update when matching vocab is used

Click 'End mission' button
Verify a results screen appears with 6 criteria scores
Verify feedback_summary text is shown
Verify review items added list is shown (words/patterns the learner missed)

title: Review items auto-created from missed conversation vocab

Verify the results screen shows 'Review items added: [list of missed vocab]'
Navigate to /review
Verify the missed vocab words appear in the review queue

title: Conversation scenario picker page loads and shows grouped scenarios
description: /u/:username/conversations/scenarios shows scenario cards grouped by CEFR level with filters
steps: Log in and navigate to /conversations (from sidebar)
Click 'Browse scenarios' or navigate to /u/:username/conversations/scenarios
Verify scenarios are grouped by level (A0-A1, A1-A2, etc.)
Verify each card shows: scenario title, level badge, description, estimated time, 'Start mission' button
Verify level filter buttons at the top allow filtering by level

title: Live mission runner has two-column layout on desktop
description: Mission page shows: left chat column (60%) with bubbles + input, right panel (40%) with target vocab chips + grammar checklist
steps: Start a conversation mission
On a desktop-sized browser, verify two-column layout
Left: chat area with tutor and learner bubbles
Right: target vocabulary chips + grammar checklist + tips section
Verify learner bubbles are right-aligned with primary blue background
Verify tutor bubbles are left-aligned with surface background

title: Target vocab chips update state during conversation
description: Vocab chips change from gray (to use) to green check (used) or yellow ! (missed) as conversation progresses
steps: Start 'Order a coffee' scenario
Verify all target vocab chips start gray
Type a message containing target vocab word (e.g. 'please')
Verify the 'please' chip turns green with a checkmark
After ending mission, verify missed words show in yellow with ! icon

title: End mission confirm modal appears when criteria not met
description: Clicking 'End mission' when not all success criteria are met shows a modal listing incomplete criteria
steps: Start a conversation mission
Click 'End mission' button after only 1-2 turns (incomplete)
Verify a confirmation modal appears
Verify the modal lists unmet success criteria
Verify 'Cancel' returns to the conversation
Verify 'End anyway' proceeds to results

title: Conversation history page shows past sessions
description: /u/:username/conversations shows list of past sessions with title, level, score, date, status
steps: Complete at least one conversation mission
Navigate to /u/:username/conversations (from sidebar 'Conversations')
Verify a list of past sessions appears
Each row shows: scenario title, CEFR level badge, score summary, started_at, status
Verify empty state shows friendly 'Try your first AI conversation' CTA for new users

title: AiMissionBlock appears in lesson activities section
description: Lesson activities section shows an AI conversation mission block with 'Start mission' CTA
steps: Navigate to /lessons/unit-1/activities
Log in if needed
Verify an 'AI Mission' block appears with a scenario description
Verify the block has a 'Start mission' button
Click the button and verify it navigates to the conversation scenario

title: Skill scores updated after completing an exercise

Complete several exercises (both correct and incorrect answers)
Navigate to /u/:username/skills
Verify skill scores are shown with non-zero values for grammar_accuracy, vocabulary_accuracy, etc.
Verify the 'Sample size' tooltip shows the number of attempts

title: Skills page shows 11-skill grid
description: /u/:username/skills shows all 11 skill cards with SkillBar, score 0-5, sample_size, last updated
steps: Navigate to http://localhost:5173/u/:username/skills (replace :username with actual username)
Or click 'Skills' in the sidebar
Verify 11 skill cards are shown in a grid layout
Each card shows: skill name, score bar (0-5), sample size, last updated
Verify skill bars fill with animation on page load

steps: Navigate to the /skills page
Verify skill bars with low scores (0-1) appear in red/orange
Verify skill bars with medium scores (2-3) appear in yellow
Verify skill bars with high scores (4-5) appear in green
Hover over a skill bar and verify tooltip shows 'Sample size: N · Last updated: <date>'

title: Per-skill deep-dive page shows history and recommended drills
description: /u/:username/skills/:skill shows history graph, recent activities, and recommended drills

Verify the deep-dive page loads
Verify a history graph shows score over time
Verify a list of recent activities shows events that affected this skill
Verify a 'Recommended drills' section shows practice items targeting this weakness

title: Dashboard shows skill breakdown mini-row
description: YourProgressCard on dashboard shows 11 compact skill bars in a mini-row under the main card
steps: Navigate to /dashboard
Find the YourProgressCard widget
Verify a 'Skill breakdown' section appears with 11 small bars
Verify clicking the skill breakdown row or 'View all skills' navigates to /skills
Verify the compact bars show in the correct colors for each skill's score

Navigate to /skills page and verify it loads data

title: Review items auto-created from wrong exercise answers

Answer an exercise incorrectly (deliberately give wrong answer)
Navigate to /u/:username/review
Verify the incorrectly answered item appears in the review queue
Verify the item shows 'Last time you said: X. What's the correct version?'

title: Review page shows drill cards with correct UI per item_type

steps: Navigate to /u/:username/review (or click 'Review' in sidebar)
Verify a full-screen card stack appears
Verify the top progress bar shows current position (e.g. '1/12')
Verify the drill card shows item content with input field
Type an answer and click Submit
Verify answer reveal animation appears with correct answer + explanation

title: Review difficulty buttons update SM-2 scheduling

steps: Complete a review item

Verify next card appears
Complete the same item again on a different day (or check stats)
Navigate to /u/:username/review/stats or verify next_review_at in review history

title: Review session summary screen shows after completing all items

steps: Complete all items in the review queue
Verify a summary screen appears (not just another card)
Summary shows: count correct/total, next 5 items due tomorrow, mastered count
Verify 'Back to dashboard' CTA button is present

title: Dashboard shows 'Today's review: N due' badge

title: Sidebar 'Review' item shows due count badge

title: Assessment start endpoint creates assessment session

Navigate to /dashboard and find 'Take A1 exit assessment' CTA
Click the CTA
Verify navigation to /u/:username/assessment/A1
Verify the assessment runner shows 'Section 1 of 6' progress indicator
Verify the first section (Listening) appears with audio + multiple choice UI

title: Assessment runner shows all 6 sections sequentially
description: Assessment runs listening → reading → vocabulary → grammar → speaking → writing sections in order
steps: Start an A1 exit assessment
Complete the Listening section (10 items)
Verify auto-advance to Reading section (article + 5 questions)
Verify auto-advance to Vocabulary section (30 word recognition items)
Verify auto-advance to Grammar section (15 cloze items)
Verify speaking section uses the AI conversation runner
Verify writing section shows textarea with word count target

title: Assessment supports pause and resume

Click the exit/pause button
Navigate away from the assessment
Return to /dashboard
Verify 'Continue A1 assessment' CTA appears
Click it and verify assessment resumes from section 3 (not the beginning)

title: Assessment pass shows confetti and updates cefr_estimate

Verify results screen shows 'Passed' verdict
Verify subtle confetti animation plays for 3 seconds
Verify 'You're now A1!' badge unlock animation
Navigate to /dashboard and verify the CEFR estimate badge now shows 'A1'

title: Assessment fail shows needs-work verdict with skill breakdown

Verify results screen shows 'Needs more work' verdict
Verify per-skill score breakdown is shown
Verify skills below 2.0 are highlighted as areas needing improvement
Verify 'Try again' and 'Back to dashboard' CTAs appear

Verify 'Take A1 exit assessment' CTA appears
